examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A user link inside a sentence. Rest the pointer on it or tab to it: after `openDelay` (500 ms) the card shows who the person is; it stays while the pointer moves onto it and closes after `closeDelay` (300 ms) or on `Esc`.

examples.name: ResourcePreview
examples.summary: Card forced open (`default-open`) on a resource name, the main use in tables: status, region, last deploy and domain, the same facts the resource page shows.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: `disabled` keeps the link and never opens the card.
